name: Efor Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Efor Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells tea and tea-like substances in Turkey. Its products include bulk tea, teapot bag, cup bag tea, form fruit and herbal tea, O.P.A Ceylon tea, and out-of-home consumption tea products under the Efor Tea brand name. Efor Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was formerly known as Efor Cay Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Efor Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi in October 2025. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
